instructions: Zotero is the user's reference manager: their library of papers, books and other sources, with PDFs and other files, annotations, notes, collections and tags. Use these tools to find and read the user's sources, cite them in a citation style, add or organize items in their library, import and export them, and show them to the user in Zotero's windows. They work on the Zotero app on the user's computer, which is started if it isn't running.

tools.name: zotero_status
tools.title: Zotero status
tools.description: Check that Zotero is reachable, and get its version, the libraries (with their libraryIDs) and the permissions the user has granted this app. Call this when other Zotero tools fail, to tell the user what's wrong.

client.description: The name this app gave Zotero

until.description: When the permission ends, or null for never

tools.name: zotero_search
tools.title: Search Zotero
tools.description: Find items in a Zotero library the way Zotero's search box does. Free text matches according to mode. Clauses filter: by:smith, year:2020, year:2015-2020, after:2019, before:2021, in:Nature (publication), type:book, tag:"to read", abstract:crispr, fulltext:crispr (attachment content), added:2024, `added in the last 7 days`, and any field by its name, e.g. doi:10.1038, `title starts with grounded`, `citation key:smith2020`. no and has test whether a field is empty or a thing exists: `no doi`, `has abstract`, `no tags`, `no attachments`, `no notes`, `has annotations`; `number of notes > 2` compares counts. Annotations match by type:annotation, color:yellow, `annotation comment:unclear`. Combine clauses with and/or and parentheses. Matches in notes, attachments and annotations return the item they belong to, unless the query is type:note, type:attachment or type:annotation.

query.description: Empty lists all items in the scope

mode.description: What free text matches: title, creators and year; all fields, tags and notes; or those and attachment full text. Defaults to the user's search mode.

direction.description: Defaults to newest first for dates, A to Z otherwise

file.description: The best PDF, EPUB or snapshot attachment

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the item in Zotero

nextOffset.description: Present when there are more results

tools.name: zotero_get_items
tools.title: Get Zotero items
tools.description: Get the full data of items, in Zotero web API JSON, with their attachments and notes.

items.description: The item's fields, creators, tags, collections and so on, plus these

path.description: The file on this computer, to open it yourself, e.g. to look at a figure. Absent if the file isn't on this computer.

tools.name: zotero_list_collections
tools.title: List Zotero collections
tools.description: List a library's collections, or a collection's subcollections at any depth, with how many items each has. The count is of the items directly in the collection, not in its subcollections; zotero_search with the collectionKey lists them.

itemCount.description: Items directly in the collection, not in its subcollections

tools.name: zotero_list_tags
tools.title: List Zotero tags
tools.description: List a library's tags with how many items have each. Colored tags, which the user assigned to number keys, come first.

tools.name: zotero_list_saved_searches
tools.title: List Zotero saved searches
tools.description: List a library's saved searches, with their conditions and how many items each finds. Show one to the user with zotero_select's savedSearchKey; get its items with zotero_search, or zotero_select's selection.

itemCount.description: Top-level items it finds, as its view shows them

link.description: zotero:// link that shows it in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_search_fulltext
tools.title: Search Zotero full text
tools.description: Find where words or phrases occur in the text of PDFs, EPUBs, web page snapshots and other files in a Zotero library, and get the passage around each match, with its page and a link that opens the file there. Matches words, not meaning: every word or "quoted phrase" in the query must occur in a file, ignoring case and accents, and a word also matches words it starts ("archive" matches "archives"). Only files Zotero has indexed are searched, and by default only the first 100 pages of a PDF. Files are listed by when their item was last modified, not by relevance. Use zotero_read_text to read more around a passage, and zotero_search with fulltext: to combine full text with other criteria.

query.description: Words and "quoted phrases", e.g. 'carbon "soil organic matter"'

keys.description: Only these items' files, given by item or attachment keys

collectionKey.description: Only the files of items in this collection

parentKey.description: The key of the item it belongs to

textPending.description: Zotero is still getting the file's text, so its passages are missing

passages.description: Passages with the most query terms first

page.description: PDF page, from 1, for zotero_read_text and links

pageLabel.description: The page number printed on the page, for citing, when Zotero has it

offset.description: Character offset in a file without pages, for zotero_read_text

link.description: zotero:// link that opens the file, at the page for a PDF

nextOffset.description: Present when there are more files

tools.name: zotero_read_text
tools.title: Read text from a Zotero file
tools.description: Read the text of a PDF, EPUB, web page snapshot or text file in Zotero. PDFs are read by page, with page labels (the page numbers printed on the pages, for citing) and the outline when Zotero has them; other files by character offset. Give an attachment key, or an item key to read its best file. Returns about maxChars characters per call, and nextPage or nextOffset to continue.

key.description: An attachment's key, or an item's key for its best file

startPage.description: PDF page to start at, from 1. Defaults to 1.

offset.description: Character offset to start at, for files without pages

link.description: zotero:// link that opens the file

label.description: The page number printed on the page

nextPage.description: Present when there are more pages in the range

tools.name: zotero_get_notes
tools.title: Get Zotero notes and annotations
tools.description: Get notes and annotations (highlights, underlines, comments and so on made in Zotero's reader). For an item, returns its notes and the annotations in its files; for an attachment, its annotations; or give note or annotation keys. Notes come as Markdown by default. Annotations are in the order they're in the file, with the page label for citing and a link that opens the file at the annotation. Image and ink annotations (areas or drawings the user marked) have an imagePath once Zotero has rendered them; get the others' with zotero_render_annotation_images. Images in notes show as [image] in Markdown, and come in images in the same order, with their files.

keys.description: Item, attachment, note or annotation keys

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the note in Zotero

images.description: Images in the note, in order

path.description: The image file, if it's on this computer

pageLabel.description: The page number printed on the page, for citing

link.description: zotero:// link that opens the file at the annotation

imagePath.description: For an image or ink annotation Zotero has rendered, a PNG of it. Read it now rather than keep the path: Zotero replaces the file when the annotation changes.

missing.description: Keys that don't exist or are in the trash

tools.name: zotero_render_annotation_images
tools.title: Render Zotero annotation images
tools.description: Get PNG files of image and ink annotations in PDFs (areas or drawings the user marked), rendering the ones Zotero hasn't rendered yet. Use it for annotations zotero_get_notes gives no imagePath for, e.g. to see a figure the user marked. Rendering opens the PDF, and renders its other missing images too. Read the files now rather than keep the paths: Zotero replaces a file when its annotation changes.

status.description: rendering: Zotero is still rendering it

tools.name: zotero_get_context
tools.title: Get what the user is looking at in Zotero
tools.description: Get what the user has open and selected in Zotero's main window, so requests like "summarize this paper", "the page I'm on", "the passage I selected" or "the papers I selected" can be answered. Returns the selected library, collections and items in the library tab, and which tab is active. If it's a PDF, EPUB or web page snapshot in Zotero's reader, it also returns the file, the page the user is on, the text they've selected and the annotations they've selected; if it's a note, the note. It also lists the tabs of all of Zotero's windows, with the IDs zotero_select, zotero_open and zotero_close take. Returns window: false when no Zotero window is open.

window.description: Whether a Zotero window is open. The rest describes the one the user used last.

tab.description: The active tab's kind: library, reader, note or another kind

libraryTabID.description: The library tab the selection below is from: the active one, or the one used last

libraryID.description: The library selected in the library tab

selectedItems.description: Items selected in the library tab, at most 50

reader.description: The file open in the active reader tab

path.description: The file on this computer, to open it yourself, e.g. to look at a figure. Absent if the file isn't on this computer.

page.description: PDF page the user is on, from 1

pageLabel.description: The page number printed on that page, for citing

link.description: zotero:// link that opens the file, at the page for a PDF

note.description: The note open in the active note tab

current.description: The window the user used last

type.description: library, reader, note or another kind

key.description: The file or note a reader or note tab shows

page.description: PDF page a reader tab is on, from 1

collectionKey.description: The collection a library tab shows

savedSearchKey.description: The saved search a library tab shows

tools.name: zotero_select
tools.title: Show items in Zotero
tools.description: Show a library, collection or saved search in a Zotero library tab, with the given items, or all of its items, selected, so the user can see them. Replaces what the tab shows, including any search or tag filter. Opens Zotero's window if none is open. Changes only what Zotero shows, not the library.

keys.description: Items to select. Only items in the collection or saved search can be selected.

windowID.description: A window from zotero_get_context. Defaults to the window the user used last.

tabID.description: A library tab from zotero_get_context. Defaults to the window's library tab used last.

newTab.description: Show them in a new library tab

newWindow.description: Show them in a new window

focus.description: Bring Zotero to the front. By default it stays behind the app the user is in.

notShown.description: Items that aren't in the collection or saved search, so weren't selected

missing.description: Keys of items that don't exist

tools.name: zotero_open
tools.title: Open a file or note in Zotero
tools.description: Open a PDF, EPUB or web page snapshot in Zotero's reader, or a note, for the user to see, and scroll the reader to a page or an annotation. Give an item's key to open its best file. If it's already open, its tab is selected and scrolled instead, unless newTab is given. Changes only what Zotero shows, not the library.

key.description: An attachment, a note, or a regular item to open its PDF, EPUB or snapshot

page.description: PDF page to scroll to, from 1, as zotero_read_text and zotero_search_fulltext give

pageLabel.description: The page number printed on the page, for a PDF or an EPUB with page numbers

annotationKey.description: An annotation of the file to scroll to and select

windowID.description: A window from zotero_get_context. Defaults to the window the user used last.

newTab.description: Open another tab even if it's already open

newWindow.description: Open it in a new window

focus.description: Bring Zotero to the front. By default it stays behind the app the user is in.

tools.name: zotero_close
tools.title: Close Zotero tabs or windows
tools.description: Close tabs and windows by their IDs from zotero_get_context. The user can reopen them with Zotero's Reopen Closed Tab. Pinned tabs, and Zotero's last tab outside macOS, can't be closed.

tools.name: zotero_generate_citation
tools.title: Generate Zotero citations
tools.description: Format items in a citation style: as one citation (with page or other locators), as a bibliography, or, with format document, all of a document's citations at once. Use format document when writing a document with several citations: give its citations in the order they appear, and get each one formatted and the bibliography, with numbering, disambiguation (Smith 2020a, 2020b) and ibid. or short forms worked out across the document, as Zotero's word processor plugins do. A citation formatted on its own always starts at [1] in a numeric style. For BibTeX, RIS and other export formats, use zotero_export. Defaults to the style the user copies citations with. A style that isn't installed is installed from the Zotero Style Repository if the user allows it.

items.description: For format citation or bibliography, in citation order

citations.description: For format document: the document's citations in the order they appear, each the items cited together in one place

style.description: A style's short name, e.g. "apa", or its ID

citations.description: For format document, each citation in the order given

bibliography.description: For format document. Empty for a style without one.

noteStyle.description: For format document: whether the style puts citations in footnotes, one footnote per citation

tools.name: zotero_update_items
tools.title: Edit Zotero items
tools.description: Change items' metadata, tags and collections: set or clear fields (title, date, DOI, abstractNote and so on), replace creators, add or remove tags, and add items to or remove them from collections. Use it to tag, retitle, correct or file items. Up to 50 items per call. The whole call succeeds or changes nothing: if any change is invalid (an unknown key, or a field the item's type doesn't have), the error says why and nothing is changed. The user can undo the whole call in Zotero with Edit → Undo. Zotero asks the user for permission unless it was already granted.

fields.description: Fields to set, by Zotero field name (as in zotero_get_items), e.g. {"title": "…", "date": "2020-05"}. An empty string clears a field.

creators.description: Replaces all of the item's creators, in order

name.description: Instead of firstName and lastName, for an organization or a one-part name

addToCollections.description: Collection keys. An item stays in the collections it's already in.

removeFromCollections.description: Collection keys. The item stays in the library.

items.description: The items as they are now

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the item in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_manage_collections
tools.title: Create, rename or move a Zotero collection
tools.description: Create a collection, rename one, or move one into another collection or to the top level. To put items in a collection, use zotero_update_items. The user can undo the call in Zotero with Edit → Undo, which moves a new collection to the trash. Zotero asks the user for permission unless it was already granted.

key.description: The collection to rename or move

parentKey.description: For create, the collection to create it in (top level if omitted). For move, where to move it, or null for the top level.

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the collection in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_manage_saved_searches
tools.title: Manage Zotero saved searches
tools.description: Create a saved search, which shows in Zotero's collection pane and keeps finding matching items as the library changes, or rename one or change its query. The query uses zotero_search's syntax. To delete one, use zotero_trash. The user can undo it in Zotero with Edit → Undo. Zotero asks the user for permission unless it was already granted.

key.description: For update, the saved search's key

query.description: As for zotero_search, e.g. `tag:"to read" no notes`

mode.description: How free text in the query matches, as for zotero_search. Defaults to the search box's mode.

link.description: zotero:// link that shows it in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_add_note
tools.title: Add a Zotero note
tools.description: Add a note, written in Markdown, under an item (a child note) or as a standalone note, optionally in a collection. Supports CommonMark with tables, ~~strikethrough~~ and TeX math: $…$ inline, and display math between lines of just $$. As when Markdown is pasted into a Zotero note, dollar signs only become math around something that looks like math (a TeX command, braces or an operator), so $x$ alone or $5 stays text. Raw HTML is shown as text, and images become links. The user can undo it in Zotero with Edit → Undo, which moves the note to the trash. Zotero asks the user for permission unless it was already granted.

markdown.description: The note. Its first line becomes its title, so start with a heading.

parentKey.description: The regular item (e.g. a journal article) to add the note under

collectionKey.description: For a standalone note, a collection to put it in

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the note in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_manage_tags
tools.title: Manage Zotero tags
tools.description: Change tags across a whole library: rename a tag, merge several into one by renaming them all to the same name (which may be an existing tag), delete tags from every item that has them, or set or remove a tag's color. Tag names match exactly, including case, as zotero_list_tags lists them. To change the tags of particular items, use zotero_update_items. The user can undo renaming and deleting in Zotero with Edit → Undo, though not color changes. Zotero asks the user for permission unless it was already granted.

color.description: For setColor: #rrggbb, or null to remove the color. Colored tags show first in the tag selector and as colored dots on items; at most 9 tags can have colors.

position.description: For setColor: the number key that toggles the tag on selected items. Defaults to its current one, or the next free one.

itemCount.description: For rename and delete, the items changed

tools.name: zotero_edit_note
tools.title: Edit a Zotero note
tools.description: Add Markdown to the end of a note, or replace its content, with the same Markdown as zotero_add_note. Give the note's dateModified from zotero_get_notes: if the note changed since, e.g. because the user edited it, nothing is changed and you get it again first. Replacing works only on notes without highlights, citations or images, which Markdown can't hold; append to the others. The user can undo it in Zotero with Edit → Undo. Zotero asks the user for permission unless it was already granted.

mode.description: replace: the Markdown becomes the whole note, and its first line the note's title

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the note in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_list_duplicates
tools.title: List duplicate Zotero items
tools.description: List the sets of items Zotero considers duplicates, as its Duplicate Items view does: items with the same DOI or ISBN, or with similar titles, the same creators and years close together. Check that a set really is one work, e.g. not a preprint and its published version the user keeps apart, before merging it with zotero_merge_items. Each set is oldest first.

tools.name: zotero_merge_items
tools.title: Merge duplicate Zotero items
tools.description: Merge items that are the same work, as Zotero's merge button does: the master item keeps its own fields and gets the others' notes, files, annotations, tags, collections and related items, and the others go to the trash. Duplicate PDFs are combined, keeping the annotations of each. To use a field value from another copy, set it on the master with zotero_update_items. The items must be regular items of the same type. The user can undo it in Zotero with Edit → Undo. Zotero asks the user for permission unless it was already granted.

masterKey.description: The item to keep, one of keys. Defaults to the oldest.

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the master item in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_trash
tools.title: Move to or restore from the Zotero trash
tools.description: Move items (with their notes and attachments), collections (with their subcollections) or saved searches to the trash, or restore them from it. Items in a trashed collection stay in the library. The user can restore trashed things from the trash, or undo the whole call in Zotero with Edit → Undo, until the trash is emptied. Zotero asks the user for permission unless it was already granted: to trash, for an hour at most.

collections.description: Without subcollections of other collections given, which went with them

tools.name: zotero_add_items
tools.title: Add items to Zotero
tools.description:
Add items to a Zotero library, with their metadata looked up, and look for their PDFs. For BibTeX, RIS or another import format, use zotero_import. Ways to add, best first:
- identifiers: DOIs, ISBNs, arXiv IDs or PubMed IDs, or URLs that contain one (doi.org, a publisher's article page with the DOI in its URL, arxiv.org, pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov). Zotero doesn't add other web pages: the user saves those with the Zotero Connector in their browser.
- items: item JSON, for something without an identifier whose metadata you found yourself.
If looking up identifiers takes too long, the call returns before they're all done: those still being looked up say inProgress, and Zotero adds them when their lookup finishes. By default Zotero then looks for each new item's PDF or EPUB as its Find Available PDF does, from the user's computer, so access through their institution works. If it finds none, find a copy elsewhere and attach it with zotero_add_attachment; as a last resort, ask the user to save it with the Zotero Connector. The user can undo the call in Zotero with Edit → Undo, which moves the new items to the trash. Zotero asks the user for permission unless it was already granted.

items.description: Item JSON in the Zotero web API format, as zotero_get_items returns, e.g. {"itemType": "report", "title": "…", "creators": [{"creatorType": "author", "firstName": "Ann", "lastName": "Lee"}], "date": "2024", "institution": "…", "url": "…"}. Only fields of the item type are accepted.

collectionKey.description: A collection to add the items to

findFiles.description: Look for PDFs and EPUBs. Defaults to the user's setting for attaching them when saving items.

results.description: One per item, in the order given. An identifier or text can give several.

status.description: inProgress: Zotero is still looking up the identifier, and adds its item when it finds it.

file.description: The item's PDF, EPUB or snapshot

fileSearch.description: For a new item without a file: whether Zotero is still looking for one

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the item in Zotero

notice.description: What to do about files Zotero didn't find, and identifiers it's still looking up

tools.name: zotero_find_full_text
tools.title: Find full text in Zotero
tools.description: Look for a PDF or EPUB of items that have none, as Zotero's Find Full Text menu command does: by DOI, URL or PMCID, from open-access sources and from the publisher's site, through the user's institution where they have access. Use it for items added without files, e.g. by zotero_import. Items that already have a PDF or EPUB, or have no DOI, URL or PMCID, are skipped. If the search takes too long, the call returns and Zotero goes on in the background. The user can undo it in Zotero with Edit → Undo, which moves the files found to the trash. Zotero asks the user for permission unless it was already granted.

tools.name: zotero_add_attachment
tools.title: Attach a file in Zotero
tools.description: Attach a PDF, EPUB or other file to an item: from a URL, which Zotero downloads, or from a file on this computer, e.g. one you downloaded or one in the user's Downloads folder. Without parentKey, adds a file on this computer as a standalone attachment and has Zotero identify it from its contents (a PDF's or EPUB's DOI, ISBN or title page), creating its parent item, as Zotero does when the user adds a file on its own; use this to bring the user's existing PDFs into Zotero, one call per file. Attach to an item when zotero_add_items finds no PDF and you've found a copy elsewhere, such as on arXiv, PubMed Central or the author's site. A URL can be a link to a PDF or EPUB, or a page that links to one; it's downloaded from the user's computer, so access through their institution works. If Zotero can't get the file, as a last resort ask the user to save it with the Zotero Connector from a browser where they're signed in. The user can undo it in Zotero with Edit → Undo, which moves the attachment, and a parent item Zotero created, to the trash. Zotero asks the user for permission unless it was already granted.

parentKey.description: The regular item (e.g. a journal article) to attach the file to. Omit to add a file from path as a standalone attachment that Zotero identifies.

url.description: http or https, with parentKey. Only PDFs and EPUBs are attached from URLs.

path.description: The absolute path of a file on this computer

linkFile.description: Link to the file at path where it is, instead of copying it into Zotero

collectionKey.description: Without parentKey, a collection to add the file and the item Zotero creates for it to

title.description: The attachment's title. By default Zotero names it, e.g. "Full Text PDF".

status.description: downloading: Zotero is still downloading the file

identified.description: Without parentKey, whether Zotero identified the file and created its parent item. pending: Zotero is still identifying it.

parent.description: The item Zotero created for the file

path.description: The file on this computer, to open it yourself, e.g. to look at a figure. Absent if the file isn't on this computer.

link.description: zotero:// link that opens the file in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_import
tools.title: Import into Zotero
tools.description: Import a file on this computer, or text, in a format Zotero imports: BibTeX, BibLaTeX, RIS, Zotero RDF, CSL JSON, MODS, EndNote XML and others. Like File → Import, the PDFs and other files a file refers to are imported too, and a file's items go into a new collection named after it unless collectionKey is given. If importing takes too long, the call returns inProgress and Zotero finishes in the background. Zotero doesn't check whether the items are already in the library. The user can undo the import in Zotero with Edit → Undo, which moves the new items and collections to the trash. Zotero asks the user for permission unless it was already granted.

collectionKey.description: A collection to add the items to

newCollection.description: Put the items in a new collection. Defaults to true for a file and false for text.

linkFiles.description: Link to the files a file refers to where they are, instead of copying them into Zotero

collectionKey.description: The collection the items went into

tools.name: zotero_export
tools.title: Export from Zotero
tools.description: Export items, a collection with its subcollections, or a whole library, in an export format, as text or to a new file on this computer. Formats include BibTeX, BibLaTeX, RIS, Zotero RDF, CSL JSON, CSV, MODS, EndNote XML and Markdown or HTML for notes; an unknown format gives the full list. Large exports must be written to a file. An existing file is replaced only with overwrite. BibTeX and BibLaTeX exports also give the citation key of each item, to cite them by in Markdown for Pandoc.

format.description: An export format's name, e.g. "BibTeX" or "CSL JSON"

keys.description: Items to export. Defaults to the whole library.

path.description: An absolute path to write to, where nothing exists yet. Without it, the export is returned as text.

includeFiles.description: Also copy the items' files, with their annotations. path is then a new folder, with the export file inside it.

overwrite.description: Replace a file already at path. A folder, or an export with includeFiles, is never replaced.

output.description: The export, when no path was given

folder.description: The folder with the file and the items' files, for includeFiles

status.description: writing: Zotero is still writing the file

citationKeys.description: For BibTeX and BibLaTeX, of up to 500 items: the item keys of the regular items exported, each with its citation key in the export
